study.question: Can non-target static fields improve history retrieval beyond an equally sized target-only adapter, especially when no target category occurs in the supplied history? Observed seed-42 validation AUC/Logloss: static 0.6050036144838207/0.19725549413961715; pooled 0.6102261137080656/0.19708646342353378; DIN 0.6133619861190683/0.19679464647483236 (3,234,051 impressions each). DIN-minus-pooled within-slice AUC gain is 0.0026743907094257 with category match (2,516,922 rows, 129,821 positives, 2,387,101 negatives), versus 0.0002617449941049 without (717,129 rows, 29,616 positives, 687,513 negatives). The latter includes 8,272 empty histories (310 positives, 7,962 negatives). This descriptive between-slice difference is not a causal interaction or significance test. Source inspection shows the baseline query is category+brand; other fields reach only the classifier. Category, brand, action and recency are added into each event before pooling. The observed limitation motivates this small query experiment; it does not establish its explanation. Baseline costs are 484.38, 570.41 and 614.29 wall seconds respectively. Public baseline source identity is reproduced; training/data readiness is inherited from the host contract and cannot be independently rerun or audited in this coding phase.
study.hypothesis: A category+brand query may lack context needed to rank useful cross-category or action/recency events for some impressions. A small residual derived from other existing field embeddings may change that retrieval. This is a hypothesis, not controlled support: a gain over matched target-only and context-readout replacements plus repeated validation is needed before attributing performance to this route.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit target-conditioned local activation. Add a residual query from other static fields. Retain the local baseline softmax, whereas original DIN relaxes weight normalization to preserve intensity. This study does not test that separate intensity mechanism or reproduce the complete DIN recipe.

Exact local ancestor: inherit every embedding, history encoding, attention and classifier layer. Add only a zero-initialized 2128-parameter adapter; use input/route replacements to distinguish context from extra capacity.

Source read, not executed: author implementation has separate matching/relevance components and auxiliary matching loss with category/brand histories. This candidate changes query context only, preserving the local click loss. DMR publisher paper was inaccessible, so no full-paper reproduction claim is made.

inherited_components: Exact baseline SHA256 ee10868f589c077b19f57a1fb07702c947c56e970994cdc537ef83ea2b8bc943 and all frozen data/label/sample identities; no raw data or item-history input is available to model code.
16-dimensional field embeddings, shared category/brand lookup for target and history, action and log2-age embeddings, additive event encoding.
Original 4-way local activation input [query, history, query-history, query*history], 64-unit PReLU attention, masked normalized softmax with zero empty-history pooling.
Static field concatenation plus one 16-dimensional pooled history vector, ReLU classifier widths [128,64], host scratch training and BCE/optimizer with lr=0.001.
study.proposed_difference: Use an equal-weight square-root-normalized sum of embeddings at every non-category/non-brand static field index; no assumptions about unseen field names or additional inputs. Map this 16-vector through Linear(16,64), ReLU, Linear(64,16); add its output to category+brand only before attention. Zero the last adapter layer at initialization, construct it after parent layers, and gate it off on empty histories. If there are no other fields, the context summary is zero; report that scope failure rather than invent inputs. Target-query and context-readout replacements have exactly the same 2128 extra parameters and initial parent function. The proposal tests a mechanism-distinct local candidate relative to supplied baselines; it makes no literature novelty or priority claim. There are no measured candidate results yet; all controlled/repeated support is pending host execution.
predictions: Primary performance prediction: context-query has higher full-population validation ROC-AUC than baseline-din and target-query-control under the frozen training recipe. Logloss and cost are reported even if unfavorable.

Mechanism-specific prediction: context-query also improves the host category-match-absent slice over target-query-control and exceeds context-readout-control overall. Candidate slice comparisons are prospectively specified here; their motivation from ancestor slices remains exploratory.

Checkpoint diagnostics should show nonzero adapter norms and changed attention distributions in supported nonempty category-no-overlap impressions. Empty histories have exactly zero adapter contribution. These checks are necessary implementation evidence, not sufficient causal evidence.

All three variants should have parent parameters +2128 = 17,132,403 total and 53,715 dense parameters at default dimensions; embeddings stay 17,078,688. Host counts, wall time, allocated GPU seconds, memory, processed examples and inference p50/p95/throughput must verify actual cost; approximate arithmetic matching is not equal-compute evidence.
Any consequential positive direction should retain sign over paired seeds 42,43,44 and receive user-cluster paired uncertainty if authorized later. A single seed cannot establish significance.
falsifiers: If the context adapter does not improve AUC over the target-only capacity replacement or plain DIN, the proposed useful-context effect is unsupported for this implementation.
If the readout replacement performs as well or better, evidence does not identify contextual retrieval as the source of any improvement.
If apparent gains disappear across paired seeds, are confined to unrelated slices, or come with unacceptable Logloss/cost, do not promote the proposed mechanism.

Zero learned adaptation or zero attention/logit changes in adequately supported nonempty diagnostics indicates an inactive/ineffective implementation; distinguish that from a tested universal mechanism refutation.

Nonfinite outputs, API/source-check failures, host timeouts, absent non-target fields or inability to maintain the frozen information boundary are execution/prerequisite problems, not scientific counterevidence. Preserve their costs and receipts.
alternative_explanations: No useful cross-category signal may exist in coarse category/brand/action/time histories; the 128-event prefix may have truncated relevant events.
Absent category matches may reflect empty histories, missing/unknown encoded identities, training support, action composition, user frequency or time rather than a weak query.
Extra nonlinear capacity, a different optimization path or embedding gradients may explain improvements; target-only and readout replacements only partially address these alternatives.
Equal-weight summation of other fields can erase field identity or be dominated by correlated identifiers. A null result would leave more selective query construction open.
Softmax intensity loss or additive mixing of category/brand/action/time may be the actual limitation; both are intentionally held fixed. No combined change is tested without factorial controls.
Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented under the inherited protocol. This benchmark assumption remains unresolved and results cannot establish production point-in-time validity.

Only three successful reference trajectories are available; no negative candidate trajectories have been hidden or reclassified. First-512 validation diagnostics are small, ordered and unrepresentative, with no labels or slice AUC.

contrasts.intervention: context-query: add adapter(sum of existing non-category/non-brand field embeddings / sqrt(number of such fields)) to the original category+brand query before the inherited local activation unit; no adapter output enters the classifier directly.
contrasts.control: target-query-control: identical adapter and residual query route, using (target category embedding + target brand embedding)/sqrt(2) as its input. This is the primary capacity replacement. Compare both with the existing unmodified baseline-din.
held_fixed: All first-six-day exposures, natural class ratio, three epochs, batch 4096, 128 supplied causal events, scratch initialization and paired seed 42 for screening
Shared 16-dimensional field/category/brand/action/recency embeddings; inherited age binning, local activation network, masked softmax and 128/64 classifier
Host optimizer and binary click loss; lr=0.001; no auxiliary supervision, dropout, input expansion, target leakage or new identifiers
One residual adapter with 2128 trainable parameters (16->64->16), same initialization, dimensions and placement after all parent layers in construction order; final adapter layer initialized to zero
Same static field concatenation and one history pooling vector at classifier; adapter output gated to zero for empty histories; all modes compute the same non-target field summary
remaining_confounds: Equal parameter counts are not equal effective statistical capacity: context includes more information and has different covariance, support and scale despite square-root normalization.
Changing adapter inputs changes gradients to shared embeddings and subsequent learning, so a gain cannot by itself prove better semantic retrieval.
Seed-42 baseline and slice receipts are exploratory; no paired predictions, cluster intervals or training-defined support intersections are exposed in this phase.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If context-query improves full validation AUC over both target-query-control and baseline-din, with a consistent improvement in the category-match-absent slice, retain it provisionally and request paired-seed validation and authorized user-cluster uncertainty later. Inspect Logloss, cost and diagnostics before a mechanism claim.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If both adapters improve equally, prefer the simpler target-only explanation. If context-query is worse or null, retain the result; inspect adaptation magnitude, supported nonempty slice counts and the readout replacement before deciding whether a narrower discriminating follow-up fits the budget. One weak mean-context implementation does not refute all contextual retrieval.

contrasts.intervention: context-query routes the non-target field adapter through attention scores and leaves pooled history values unchanged.
contrasts.control: context-readout-control: identical context input, adapter, zero initialization and parameters, but retain the original target-only query and add the adapter output to the pooled history vector before the unchanged classifier. This is a replacement, not an additional simultaneous mechanism.
held_fixed: All first-six-day exposures, natural class ratio, three epochs, batch 4096, 128 supplied causal events, scratch initialization and paired seed 42 for screening
Shared 16-dimensional field/category/brand/action/recency embeddings; inherited age binning, local activation network, masked softmax and 128/64 classifier
Host optimizer and binary click loss; lr=0.001; no auxiliary supervision, dropout, input expansion, target leakage or new identifiers
One residual adapter with 2128 trainable parameters (16->64->16), same initialization, dimensions and placement after all parent layers in construction order; final adapter layer initialized to zero
Same static field concatenation and one history pooling vector at classifier; adapter output gated to zero for empty histories; all modes compute the same non-target field summary
remaining_confounds: Query and readout routes have different optimization geometry and representational functions; nominal capacity and nearly equal arithmetic do not equate effective capacity or measured runtime.
Shared field embeddings can change in both routes; the readout control tests an extra contextual nonlinear path, not every possible non-retrieval explanation.
Attention changes and checkpoint-local removal effects are descriptive; learned attention is not ground-truth relevance.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If context-query beats the readout replacement as well as the target-only replacement and baseline, advance a provisional retrieval-route explanation to paired repetitions. Keep all controls in the frozen assessment suite if this mechanism is claimed.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If context-readout matches or exceeds context-query, report that contextual capacity or nonlinear readout suffices and withhold a retrieval-specific claim. Do not combine routes without a newly recorded factorial plan and adequate budget.
